items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: he had the writers in the band, like Gene Sedric Sedgewick

ctx.x: So he had a lot of imagination?

Yes, he did. But he wasn't a jazz writer. AT all. He didn't approve of that, so he had the writers in the band, like Gene Sedric Sedgewick, Jerry Blake, Jerry Blake was exceptional, he was a very modern arranger at that time. If you hear Sam's album, you can hear lot of Jerry Blake's arrangements.
